# Official source fixtures

Retrieved read-only on 2026-10-18 from:

- RSS: https://esawebb.org/images/feed/
- Image: https://esawebb.org/images/weic2621d/
- Archive: https://esawebb.org/images/?sort=-release_date

`detail.html` and `archive.html` retain only the relevant real public metadata markup; site JavaScript, layout, styling, logos and unrelated navigation were removed. The RSS fixture retains the official feed. Text: ESA/Webb. Full credit for the image metadata: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI, T. Nanayakkara (USYD). Image Processing: J. DePasquale (STScI). Content is used under [ESA/Webb's CC BY 4.0 reuse policy](https://esawebb.org/copyright/). No image binary is stored.

The observed feed had a latest release date of 2026-10-08. This is an archive selection, not a photograph newly released on the retrieval date.
